requirements_source.document: No separate requirements document was supplied
requirements_source.access: Scope taken from the project's README.md (AI-supported support tickets).

repository.import_method: Uploaded folder. The support-ticket-system.zip in Downloads was not compared with it. No original snapshot was used, so code changes cannot be compared with a baseline.
repository.framework: FastAPI (Python) with one static page (app/static) using vanilla JavaScript.
repository.backend: Python 3.12, FastAPI + Uvicorn, Pydantic; SQLite (DATABASE_PATH); optional OpenAI classifier with a rule-based fallback.
repository.routes: Dashboard at /; JSON API under /api (tickets create/list/get/patch, stats, config); interactive docs at /docs.

requirements.text: Users submit tickets; staff can correct category and priority by hand and move tickets Open, In Progress, Resolved.
requirements.result: Stated in README; covered by tests/test_api.py.

requirements.text: Tickets are classified (technical issue, billing or general inquiry) with a recommended priority and reasoning.
requirements.result: Stated in README. The rule-based path is tested. The GPT path is tested with a mock only; no real OpenAI call was made.

requirements.text: If the LLM fails, times out or returns invalid JSON, the ticket is still saved using the fallback.
Manual values win; the original AI suggestion is kept so overrides can be counted.
requirements.result: Stated in README; the dashboard counts corrections.

requirements.text: Ticket text is treated as untrusted (prompt-injection hardening); output is validated against enums; the UI escapes text; SQL uses bound parameters.

tools.name: FastAPI + Uvicorn
tools.reason: REST API and static dashboard; the project's stated choice.

tools.name: Pydantic
tools.reason: Input validation, enums and response schemas.

tools.name: SQLite (standard library)
tools.reason: Persistent ticket storage with no server.

tools.name: OpenAI GPT (gpt-4o-mini)
tools.reason: Classification, priority and reasoning. Needs OPENAI_API_KEY; the tests mock it, so no paid call was made here.

tools.name: Rule-based classifier
tools.reason: Free keyword classifier used when no API key is set or the API call fails.

tools.name: pytest + httpx TestClient
tools.reason: Automated tests without network or API key.

limitations: The GPT classifier was not run against the real OpenAI API: no key is configured. Its behaviour is covered only by mocked tests.
No authentication or roles; no assignee field; no pagination (per the README's next steps).
The test suite writes data/tickets.db into the project folder (the default DATABASE_PATH). That file was removed after the run.
No git history or original snapshot was supplied, so changes cannot be compared with a baseline.
